_comment: Interstellar (2014) recap skeleton. 23 units covering 34 beats. Register B (Medium). Hook U01 = viral cold-open teasing the dying-Earth / last-mission premise and the MYSTERY of the ghost, WITHOUT the time-loop reveal (Cooper=ghost held to U19) and WITHOUT the ending. Earth-timeline inserts (beats 20/22/32) are narrative_jump. Climax units use G4 restraint. Ending unit U23 preserves ambiguity (Cooper's CHOICE to go find Brand, not a guaranteed reunion). Motifs woven systematically: DUST, GRAVITY, the WATCH, the CORNFIELD, LOVE-across-time. Target ~3050 words / ~15-16 min at the calibrated Andrew +22% rate (3.5 w/s). must_cover lists the beat numbers each unit covers.

units.label: Hook - a dying Earth and one last mission
units.why: Viral cold-open: a dust-choked dying Earth, a farmer who used to be a pilot, a strange presence in his daughter's room, and a secret mission to find humanity a new home. Tease the premise + the ghost MYSTERY + a question hook + channel intro. NO time-loop reveal (do not say the ghost is Cooper), NO ending. All hook lines narrative_jump=true.

units.label: The dust bowl and the Cooper family
units.why: Establish the world: blight, dust, a farm; Cooper the widower ex-pilot, his son Tom, daughter Murph, and Grandpa Donald. Humanity reduced from explorers to caretakers.

units.label: Murph's ghost
units.why: The bookshelf 'ghost' knocks books off Murph's shelf; Cooper tells her to be scientific and record it. Plant the DUST + GRAVITY + bookshelf mystery. TWIST-HOLD: present as unexplained anomaly only.

units.label: The drone and a world that stopped looking up
units.why: The drone chase (Cooper the pilot lights up); the school scene - textbooks call Apollo a hoax; Donald's 'we used to look up and wonder'. The theme: explorers become caretakers.

units.label: The coordinates in the dust
units.why: Dust falls in patterns; Cooper reads it as binary coordinates left by gravity. GRAVITY-as-language, still mysterious. Leads them to a hidden place.

units.label: NASA and the Lazarus mission
units.why: The coordinates lead to secret NASA; TARS; Amelia and Professor Brand. Earth is dying; the Lazarus scouts, the Endurance, the wormhole near Saturn.

units.label: Plan A, Plan B, and the wormhole
units.why: The wormhole placed by 'them'; Plan A (solve gravity, lift everyone) vs Plan B (5,000 embryos). Cooper agrees to pilot - to come home to his kids. TWIST-HOLD: do not leak that Plan A is a lie.

units.label: The watch, the promise, the launch
units.why: The emotional core of Act 1: Cooper gives Murph his WATCH, promises he'll come back; she refuses to say goodbye (STAY). He drives away in tears; the launch. Motifs: the WATCH, LOVE / family left behind. Contains the B10 silence hug.

units.label: The Endurance and the wormhole
units.why: The crew (Amelia, Doyle, Romilly, TARS/CASE); the long cruise; Romilly's wormhole tutorial; passing THROUGH the wormhole into a new galaxy. Contains the B13 wormhole silence.

units.label: Gargantua and the cost of time
units.why: Gargantua the black hole; the choice of Miller's water planet despite time dilation - one hour there is seven years back home. TIME as the true antagonist. GRAVITY.

units.label: The water planet and the wave
units.why: Miller's shallow ocean; 'those aren't mountains, they're waves'; the giant wave; Doyle dies; the desperate escape. G4 restraint on Doyle's death. The WAVE motif, cost of TIME.

units.label: 23 years and the messages
units.why: Romilly has aged 23 years; Cooper watches decades of his children's messages, weeping - Tom grown, Donald dead, adult Murph now his age. The emotional peak. Contains the B19 messages silence. TIME, LOVE across distance.

units.label: Earth: Murph at NASA
units.why: Earth-timeline insert (narrative_jump): adult Murph now works at NASA with the dying Professor Brand on the gravity equation, still haunted by the bedroom ghost. TWIST-HOLD.

units.label: The choice: love versus data
units.why: Amelia argues love is a real force that transcends time; the crew chooses Mann's planet over Edmunds'. LOVE as the film's thesis.

units.label: Brand's confession (Plan A was a lie)
units.why: Earth-timeline insert (narrative_jump): the burning cornfield; Professor Brand's deathbed confession - Plan A was a sham, unsolvable without black-hole data; 'you left us here to starve'. The BETRAYAL reveal - distinct from the loop, which is still hidden. CORNFIELD motif.

units.label: Dr. Mann, alive
units.why: The ice planet; Dr. Mann found alive, 'the best of us', weeping with relief; his pitch about life beneath the ice.

units.label: Mann's betrayal
units.why: Mann faked all his data; he cracks Cooper's helmet and leaves him to die; KIPP's trap kills Romilly; CASE rescues Cooper. G4 restraint. The cost of the lie; LOVE (Amelia coming back).

units.label: The docking
units.why: Mann's failed docking blows open the Endurance and kills him; Cooper hand-docks the spinning, burning ship. Human skill vs the void. G4 restraint.

units.label: The sacrifice into Gargantua
units.why: Low on fuel, slingshot around Gargantua; 'leave something behind'; Cooper detaches himself so Amelia reaches Plan B; he crosses the event horizon into the black hole. LOVE and sacrifice, GRAVITY.

units.label: The tesseract and the ghost revealed
units.why: THE TWIST PAYOFF: inside the black hole Cooper finds the tesseract behind Murph's bookshelf; he IS the ghost - he knocked the books, spelled STAY, sent the coordinates. Love, not chance, drew him here. Contains the B29 tesseract silence. The loop reveal lands ONLY here.

units.label: The watch across time - Eureka
units.why: Cooper encodes the black-hole data into the WATCH via gravity; on Earth adult Murph reads it - 'Eureka' - and solves gravity, saving humanity. Earth insert at B32 is narrative_jump. The WATCH pays off the whole loop; LOVE completes it.

units.label: Cooper Station
units.why: Cooper wakes 124 years old on a vast space habitat humanity built - named for Murph, not him. Home remade; TIME survived.

units.label: Reunion and the choice to go - outro
units.why: Outro: Cooper reaches old, dying Murph; she tells him no parent should watch their child die - go. He chooses to leave to find Amelia, alone on Edmunds' planet. AMBIGUITY: state it as his CHOICE and a hopeful maybe, NOT a guaranteed reunion. Thematic close (LOVE and GRAVITY across time) + channel CTA. Contains the B34 reunion silence.
